purpose: Analyze complete paginated current-window evidence first; compare a previous baseline only as secondary context when present.

evidence_contract.current_grouped_errors: Primary complete paginated current-window evidence. All semantic family identities are visible when evidence_complete=true; detailed rows are bounded per attention band and omitted_details groups remaining identities by scope.
evidence_contract.history: Secondary context from previous_grouped_errors and previous_analysis when available. If absent, perform a current-only review.
evidence_contract.source_coverage: Scope metadata used to decide whether current and previous evidence are comparable.

decision_rules: Review current evidence before any previous baseline.
If no previous baseline exists, perform a current-only review and make no trend claim.
If a previous baseline exists, compare semantic meaning and equivalent scope only after completing the current review.
Return final_report when complete current evidence supports the report and any historical difference is understood.
